premises: Severe plastic deformation can induce a refined, eutectic microstructure with high lattice distortion in NiCoCrAl-type alloys
Lattice distortion elevates Al vacancy formation energies and migration barriers
Elevated barriers suppress Al diffusion during high-temperature oxidation
